title: A Semantic Quantum Circuit Cache for Scalable and Distributed Quantum-Classical Workflows
summary: Hybrid quantum--classical workflows often execute large ensembles of circuits that differ syntactically but implement identical operations, leading to substantial redundant computation. To address this, we introduce the Quantum Circuit Cache, a content-addressable system that detects semantic equivalence and reuses previously computed results across executions, backends, and workflow stages. Our approach combines ZX-calculus reduction with isomorphism-invariant Weisfeiler--Leman graph hashing to generate deterministic circuit identifiers, enabling constant-time lookup in distributed caches…
